title: Group Anagrams
kidExplanation: A box of words. Words that are rearrangements of each other sit at the same lunch table. We need every table of anagram friends.
plainProblem: Group strings that are anagrams of each other. Return the groups in any order.

thinkingSteps.title: Brute force idea
thinkingSteps.body: Compare every pair to see if they are anagrams. Too many comparisons.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: Anagrams share a signature: sorted letters, or a count tuple.

thinkingSteps.title: Better idea
thinkingSteps.body: Map signature → list of words. One pass builds all groups.

thinkingSteps.title: Why it is fast
thinkingSteps.body: Each word is processed once; sorting letters of a word costs its length.

pattern.name: Hash set / hash map for seen items
pattern.whenToSpot: You need fast lookups of values you already saw.

complexity.timeReason: n words; sorting each word of length k costs k log k (count-signature is O(n*k)).
complexity.spaceReason: We store all words in the groups map.

edgeCases: Duplicates and boundary values from the constraints.
commonMistakes: Coding before stating the pattern and complexity.
Off-by-one errors on indices or window edges.
Mutating data structures while iterating carelessly.
interviewTips: Name the pattern: Hash set / hash map for seen items.
State O(n * k log k) time and O(n * k) space at the end.
